what: Scoped recall should be FOCUSED: aide_recall for src/api/routes.ts should return memories scoped to the file + immediate parent directory (src/api/**) + project-wide. NOT grandparent scopes (src/**) — those are too broad and already handled by SessionStart injection. Currently scopeMatchesPath matches ALL ancestor scopes which is noisy and wastes limit slots. Need depth/distance filter on recall results, not just on blocking decisions. Also: directory trigger may still add value because directory recall returns child subdirectory memories that file recalls miss.
why: User pointed out: the point of scoped recall is to get context for THAT scope, not every ancestor. Getting src/** memories when recalling src/api/routes.ts is noise.
